module: Manages the per-mission calibration of the thresholds of a rally note compositor style (corner intensity diameters, arc lengths per intensity). Settings are stored in <missionDir>/rally/compositorCalibration.json as {version=1, styles={<style>={intensity={diameter={...}}, lengthsByIntensity={<intensity>={arcMeters={...}}}}}} and reapplied to a style's configuration at load time. A list of 'boundaries' is an ascending array of lower bounds starting at 0; the last range is open-ended (no max).
notes: A range {min, max} corresponds to [min, max[; the last range has only min.
validateBoundaries requires: a non-empty numeric array, first element 0, strictly increasing values, and (if expectedCount is given) the right length.
applyToConfig only applies the sections corner.numbering.intensity (key 'diameter') and corner.numbering.lengthsByIntensity (key 'arcMeters').

calibrationFile.desc: Path of a mission's calibration file: <missionDir>/rally/compositorCalibration.json.

returns.desc: Path, or nil if missionDir is nil.

boundariesFromList.desc: Extracts the lower bounds from a list of entries whose 'key' key is a range {min, max}. Returns nil if the list is empty, does not start at 0, is not contiguous (previous max = next min) or if a max is missing outside the last entry.

returns.desc: Lower bounds, or nil if the list is not valid.

validateBoundaries.desc: Checks that a list of bounds is valid (numeric, starts at 0, strictly increasing, right length).

applyBoundariesToList.desc: Rewrites the 'key' key of each entry in the list with the range {min, max} derived from the bounds (the last one: {min} only). Changes nothing if the bounds are invalid or of the wrong length.

list.desc: List of entries, modified in place.

load.desc: Reads the mission's calibration file. Returns a blank structure {version=1, styles={}} if the file is missing or unreadable (error logged in the latter case).

save.desc: Writes the calibration data (indented) to the mission's file, creating the folder if needed.

returns.desc: Result of jsonWriteFile (false if missionDir is nil).

setBoundaries.desc: Stores a list of bounds under styles[compositorName][groupName][key] then saves the file.

boundaries.desc: Bounds (copied; nil if a value is not numeric).

setLengthBoundaries.desc: Stores the arc length bounds of an intensity under styles[compositorName].lengthsByIntensity[intensityName].arcMeters then saves.

applyToConfig.desc: Applies the saved calibrations to a style's configuration (corner.numbering.intensity and lengthsByIntensity). Called by textCompositor:load.

returns.desc: true if at least one list was modified.
